test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses the idiom "a slip of the tongue"?

options.text: The chef burned his hand and let out a slip of the tongue.
Sneha carefully planned her speech to ensure a slip of the tongue.
Sunita lost her balance while walking and had a slip of the tongue.
Ravi misspoke during the interview; it was just a slip of the tongue.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Ravi misspoke during the interview; it was just a slip of the tongue. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"a slip of the tongue"** refers to a mistake made in speaking, usually when someone says something unintentionally or incorrectly. (जुबान का फिसलना) • **English Meaning:** It indicates a verbal error or an unintentional statement. • **Hindi Meaning:** जुबान का फिसलना • **Example:** During the meeting, the manager made a slip of the tongue and revealed confidential information. • **Explanation of Correct Sentence:** Option 4 correctly uses the idiom "a slip of the tongue" to describe Ravi misspeaking during the interview, which aligns with the meaning of the phrase. (सही वाक्य) • **Hindi Meaning:** रवि ने इंटरव्यू के दौरान गलती से कुछ गलत बोल दिया; यह जुबान का फिसलना था। • **Example:** Ravi apologized for his slip of the tongue during the important discussion. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** The chef burned his hand and let out a slip of the tongue. (जुबान का फिसलना) • **Explanation:** This sentence incorrectly uses the idiom because "a slip of the tongue" refers to a verbal error, not an expression of pain. • **Example:** The chef screamed in pain, but it wasn’t a slip of the tongue. • **Option 2:** Sneha carefully planned her speech to ensure a slip of the tongue. (जुबान का फिसलना) • **Explanation:** This sentence incorrectly implies that Sneha planned for a verbal mistake, which is contradictory to the meaning of the idiom. • **Example:** Sneha rehearsed her speech to avoid a slip of the tongue. • **Option 3:** Sunita lost her balance while walking and had a slip of the tongue. (जुबान का फिसलना) • **Explanation:** This sentence incorrectly connects physical imbalance with a verbal error, which is unrelated to the idiom. • **Example:** Sunita stumbled but didn’t have a slip of the tongue. 165:Tb7b, The correct answer is **Option 2**.
